description: This source file defines the TransactionInfo class within the Orleans.Transactions namespace. It represents transaction metadata, including transaction ID, timestamp, priority, participant access counts, exception history, and mechanisms for managing transaction state such as joining, forking, reconciliation, and abort handling.

classes.name: TransactionInfo
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a transaction, including its ID, state, participants, and exception details. Provides methods for forking transactions, joining other transactions, managing exceptions, and reconciling joined transactions.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the participants dictionary and joined queue.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new transaction with ID, timestamp, priority, and read-only flag.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Copy constructor used to create a new TransactionInfo instance from an existing one.

methods.name: Fork
methods.description: Creates a copy of the transaction info, increments the PendingCalls counter.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Adds another TransactionInfo instance to the joined queue for later reconciliation.

methods.name: MustAbort
methods.description: Determines if the transaction must abort based on stored exception or pending calls.

methods.name: RecordException
methods.description: Stores an exception related to the transaction, serializing it for later deserialization.

methods.name: ReconcilePending
methods.description: Processes all joined transactions, merging their information into the current transaction.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Merges another TransactionInfo into this one, combining participant counts, timestamp, and status.

methods.name: RecordRead
methods.description: Records a read access by a participant, updating participant counts and timestamp.

methods.name: RecordWrite
methods.description: Records a write access by a participant, updating participant counts and timestamp.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a verbose string representation of the transaction info for debugging.
